description.to: The user flings a clump of dirt and stone at the target. Crude, but it gets the job done.
Attacks with an aura blast that cannot be evaded.
The user folds its wings and plummets onto the target at terrifying speed. The impact strikes with the full weight of the fall. 10% flinch chance
The user lunges through the veil and lands a solid, bone-rattling blow before fading back. 10% chance to lower target's Defense.
Draws power from nature to attack. May lower Sp. Def.
The Pokémon sustains itself, restoring a little HP at the end of each turn.
Attacks with rays of light that sparkle like diamonds.
